fields.PRODUCT NAME: Sunny Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring cheerful vibes to your home with our Sunny Blossom Hand block Cushion Cover. Designed with vibrant yellow floral motifs spread across a soft white base and finished with a playful yellow border, this 16x16 inch cover instantly adds freshness and warmth to any setting. Crafted from premium cotton, it’s perfect for brightening up sofas, lounges, patios, or cozy corners.
